Services

The mechanical side

Every line below is the shop's own published copy: its listing, its counter board, its signs, its card. No prices are published anywhere, so none are printed here.

State Inspection & EmissionsOfficial PA station EF46+
PA state inspection and emissions, the first line of the shop's own description. Emissions testing runs as an official Drive Clean PA station, EF46, on the Commonwealth's own list.
Oil ChangesAMSOIL synthetics sold here+
Oil service off the board and the listing, with AMSOIL synthetic motor oils sold and used at the shop, per its own building signage and gallery.
Engine Work & DiagnosticsIncluding high mileage care+
Engine work and diagnostic checks, including the high mileage maintenance the shop names in its own description. Check-engine light on? The board says they check it.
Brakes, A/C & ExhaustThe rest of the board+
Brakes, A/C service, exhaust and transmission flushes round out the counter board: the full-service repair list, domestic and imported, per the shop's card.
